Thanks for editing the DeTect website!

A preview of your changes is built automatically — look for the "deploy-preview" check
below and open its link to see the site as it will look once merged.

If a check fails, the error is in the log; the most common causes are a typo in the
indentation of a `.yaml` file or a missing quote mark. Nothing is broken permanently — the
live site keeps showing the last good version until this is merged.

See `README.md` for how to add news posts, members and projects.
